user_stories.story: As a System Admin, I want to create new Organizations (Tenants), so that I can onboard new customers.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create an organization with a name and slug.
Data is strictly isolated between organizations.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to log in securely, so that I can access my organization's data.
acceptance_criteria: User can sign in with email/password.
User is redirected to their organization's dashboard upon login.

user_stories.story: As an Org Admin, I want to invite users and assign roles, so that I can delegate compliance tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Org Admin can invite users by email.
Org Admin can assign roles (e.g., Compliance Manager, Read Only).
Users inherit permissions based on roles.

user_stories.story: As an Org Admin, I want to configure organization settings (logo, colors), so that the platform reflects our brand.
acceptance_criteria: Org Admin can upload a logo.
Org Admin can set primary/secondary brand colors.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to manage my profile and notifications, so that I stay informed.
acceptance_criteria: User can update profile details (name, title).
